Class AvroReaders.RowReaderBuilder

java.lang.Object
dev.hardwood.avro.AvroReaders.RowReaderBuilder
Enclosing class:
AvroReaders
public static final class AvroReaders.RowReaderBuilder extends Object
Builds an AvroRowReader with optional projection, filter, and head/tail row limit. Mirrors ParquetFileReader.RowReaderBuilder — settings are forwarded to the underlying parquet row reader, then wrapped in an AvroRowReader with the converted schema.
